functions.formula: SUM EVEN = NOT (A XOR B XOR C XOR D XOR E XOR F XOR G XOR H XOR I)
functions.text: High when an even number (0,2,4,6,8) of inputs A-I are high.

functions.formula: SUM ODD = A XOR B XOR C XOR D XOR E XOR F XOR G XOR H XOR I
functions.text: High when an odd number (1,3,5,7,9) of inputs A-I are high.

electrical.notes: SN74S280: VCC 4.75-5.25 V, TA 0-70 C. Inputs are one 74S load (IIL -2 mA).
